Values.//cms: CmsProvider is reached over HTTP as a peer system. Leaving the base URL empty disables the ingest leg rather than failing it, so the engine can run before CMS is up.
Values.//sites: The only leg. Its channel is enterprise-level and not derived from an iTwin id, because SyncSites is the message that brings an iTwin context into being. This is the same channel REG-LOCATION reads; each subscriber holds its own session.
Values.//cir: Registering the site's identity so other systems can resolve CMS's key space. Empty CirBaseUrl leaves the site written but unregistered.
